messages:
akiko: Hey team — quick question. Our EMEA folks have a public holiday the week of Dec 27 but NA has a rolling year-end shutdown the same week. If someone in EMEA wants to swap that local holiday for a different day in Jan (so they can cover a rotation), can they do a one-time swap + carryover, or do we need to use a PTO donation/transfer?

maya: Good Q. Short answer: swaps are allowed but not automatic. We treat it as either a single-day swap (manager approved) or a formal carryover if it crosses the cutoff. For year-end shutdowns we have a blackout window for unscheduled PTO between Dec 24-31 unless pre-approved. :calendar:

jonathan: To clarify — blackout means you can't take unscheduled new PTO, but approved swaps submitted before the blackout are fine, right?

maya: Correct. If the swap is agreed and submitted before the blackout cutoff, we can approve it and mark it as scheduled. If it's requested during the blackout, managers can escalate to People Ops for exceptional approval with a coverage plan.

akiko: Thanks. Two followups: 1) What form do we use to record a swap? 2) Can teammates donate hours to another for this?
\
maya: Use the "Time-off Adjustment" form in People Portal (HR > Time-off > Adjustments). In the form put: 
```
- type: one-time swap
- original_date: 2026-12-28
- new_date: 2027-01-04
- manager_approval: yes (attach email thread)
- coverage_plan: <brief text>
```
Make sure manager signs off before the blackout.
\
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Year-end blackout dates are Dec 24-31 UTC. For exceptions, include coverage + why approval is needed. Link: https://redwood.example.com/hr/year-end
\
eric: About donations — we do have a PTO donation program but it's for medical/parental emergencies and has a quarterly window. Donation transfers for schedule convenience aren't allowed. If it's an emergency, use "PTO Donation Request" and cc people-ops.
\
jonathan: If the swap pushes hours into the next fiscal year and someone hits accrual cap, do we automatically convert to float or need manual carryover approval?
\
maya: Manual carryover required if over cap. For this scenario: if the employee would exceed the calendar-year carryover cap, submit the carryover request with the Time-off Adjustment form and choose "carryover exception". We'll route to payroll to handle accrual caps.
\
akiko: Got it. Manager approved the swap in thread — I'll attach the email and file the form now. One more: does this affect headcount planning or hiring ops for that week? We have interviews scheduled and might need backup interviewers.
\
maya: Heads up to Hiring Ops: if you need backup interviewers, put a calendar note and request interviewer cover in #recruiting. Also mark the swap on the team's shared rota so on-call and interview windows are covered.
\
akiko: Thanks everyone — filing the form and linking the coverage notes. Will ping again if People Ops needs more. :pray:
\
people-ops-bot: Ticket created: HR-4892 (PTO swap/carryover exception). Assigned to Maya.
